description.value: Mai Thai is an authentic Thai restaurant in downtown Prince George, owned by Thailand-born Nid Chuthep, who has been serving the community since 2006 with the current downtown location opening in 2017. The menu spans curries, stir-fries, soups, salmon dishes, and seafood, all prepared with fresh ingredients and daily specials, alongside a dedicated vegetarian section and gluten-free options. Cyclists can sit down for a full dine-in meal or place an online order for pickup or delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and fully corroborates OSM contact details (name, phone 250-563-7779, address 1238 5th Avenue Prince George BC V2L 3L2). Takeout is confirmed explicitly on the website ('Dine in or order take-out' and an online pickup/delivery ordering system). A dedicated 'Vegetarian' menu category with 7 items is visible on the website, and OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:gluten_free=yes; curries also list tofu/vegetables as protein choices. Bike parking, water refill, and washrooms are not mentioned on the website; OSM tags toilets=yes but the evidence rules require website confirmation, so washrooms are marked null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Thai restaurant with a functioning website and online ordering — clear inclusion.
